title: Church of Saint Francis of Assisi, São João del-Rei
sectionBasis: Standing form from IPHAN conservation descriptions, the author of the local historical inventory, the named church footprint and the original terrain. Perimeter detail and vertical dimensions are interpreted. The map height of 30 m is an approximate tower-height control.
limitations: Standing exterior reconstruction. Tower diameters and roof sections, individual stone carvings and window finish are approximate.
The church envelope is mapped. Its curving sides and the later steps and forecourt are reconstructed from published architectural descriptions.
The original terrain establishes local relief, with approximate floor and forecourt contact. The cemetery remains outside the model scope.
geometryBasis: The named church way provides the northwest front and full 12-point envelope of the church and attached rear wings. The curved nave, towers and stair and balcony profiles follow written accounts. A separate native way identifies the cemetery.
